identity.description: Gorgias is a customer-support helpdesk product (Helpdesk plans, tickets, customers, macros, views) with a public REST API documented at developers.gorgias.com and docs.gorgias.com.
identity.identity_notes: Vendor developer and help-center docs describe the Gorgias helpdesk product. gorgias.com homepage was not fetched directly.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth2 bearer access tokens for approved public apps. Specific grant type not confirmed from fetched pages.
auth.scopes_notes: OAuth2 Scopes page exists: OAuth2 scopes allow to limit your app's access to Gorgias user's account data. Full scope list not fetched.

access.production_restrictions: Public OAuth2 apps are reviewed by Gorgias's tech partnership team before listing in the in-product App Store and public App Store page. API keys are for private apps only. API key docs say 'Available on all' Helpdesk plans; whether a paid tier is required is not confirmed.

read_ops: List and retrieve for most resources
write_ops: Create, update, delete for most resources (Tickets, Customers, Macros, Rules, Tags, Teams, Users, Views, Widgets)
api.limitations: Rate limits not stated on fetched pages (a Rate Limits page exists but was not retrieved). Webhooks not in the fetched API reference; HTTP integrations are a separate feature. No official SDK found.

claims.value: Gorgias is the customer-support helpdesk product; developer docs cover its REST API
API key used as HTTP Basic (username = account email, password = API key)
claims.quote: Gorgias uses HTTP Basic Authentication with three pieces of information

claims.value: OAuth2 is required for public apps; API keys are private-app only
claims.quote: If you plan to build a public app you have to use OAuth2.

claims.value: Account owner and admins create API keys (admin-gated)
claims.quote: The account owner and admins can access the API credentials and create API keys

claims.value: API credentials available on all Helpdesk plans
Public apps reviewed by tech partnership team before listing
claims.quote: Our tech partnership team will review your app to make sure it works properly and is aligned with our expectations.

claims.value: 24 REST resource groups incl. Tickets, Ticket Messages, Customers, Macros, Rules, Views
Rate limits not stated on the reference index; separate Rate Limits page exists
Gorgias calls webhooks 'HTTP integrations' configured in Settings; sends to custom URLs with templated variables
Gorgias help center documents its own MCP server at mcp.gorgias.com/mcp, connected via browser authorization
claims.quote: the connection URL is the same: https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp

claims.value: Community Gorgias MCP servers exist (mattcoatsworth Node.js repo; NoBanks/gorgias-mcp Python placeholder)

open_questions: Exact OAuth2 grant type and scope list (OAuth2 Scopes page not fetched).
Whether a free/trial Helpdesk account is available to developers and whether a paid plan is required for API access.
Rate limit values (Rate Limits page not retrieved).
